Question ID: JOUR_U05_L03_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.DIG.03

Source: Field Photo Accuracy Check. Assignment: Create accurate visual images for a school news brief about the new water bottle refill station outside the gym. Available Images: Image A shows the actual refill station outside the gym with the blue installation sign visible. Image B shows an older hallway water fountain near the cafeteria. Image C is a close-up of a student filling a bottle, but the station label is cropped out. Image D shows the refill station after the caption writer added the location and date. Reporting Notes: The station opened Monday. The facilities manager said it is the first refill station installed near the gym. The student government sponsor said the project was funded by a campus wellness grant. Accuracy Requirement: The final visual must show the correct station, avoid misleading cropping, and include a caption that identifies what the audience is seeing. Question 1: Which image best supports the refill station report?

answer.text: A. Image B is best because it is an older and familiar water fountain.

answer.text: B. Image D best supports the report because it shows the correct station and includes location and date context.
